column3: Manami Route ・ Anxiety Saturation
There's something I'd like to ask you in person.
S-Something to ask me...?
Kirino... What is she planning...?
Plan or not... She's always full of herself.
Do you really like him? Look me straight in the eyes and say it.
Y-You're asking her that in front of me?!
Shut it. I'm not asking you.
S-Still...
That's way too blunt! Manami being who she is, she won't be able to speak in front of my sister!
See! Look at her. She's gotten all tense now.
Asking something like that right in front of me...
You're talking about Kyou-chan?
Yeah. Don't try to be vague, make it clear.
Look here Kirino... Manami may be a nice girl and all, but you can't just order her around like that.
Yes, I like him.
She said it outright?!
Hmm... To what extent?
Huh?
I'm asking how much you like him!
Are you for real?
Ahh... Ahhhhh...
Hurry up and answer.
Seriously, cut it out Kirino. You're bothering her.
You shut your mouth.
...Tch. Who do you think I'm doing this for...
Did you just say something?
Nothing. Whatever, just shut it.
Ma-Manami? Kirino's being weird, You don't need to answer her, okay?
Huh? What do you think you're saying?
Right back at you, what the heck are YOU saying?
Tch, get a clue already...
As you can see, my brother is as thick as a brick.
He's always dumb like that, he never notices things.
You don't cut your brother any slack huh...
So I want to hear it directly from you. How do you like him?
Err... Wouldn't it be better if I wasn't here?
What are you saying? The one responsible for this has to be here!
If you leave now, I'll call you a loser for the rest of your life.
Fine...
Manami... Her face is completely red.
No wonder. Everyone would be after being pushed into a corner and asked that kind of thing.
Hey, you listening?
Kirino, cut it out already!
...Say it clearly.
If you don't, this idiot won't get it.
You see, he didn't realize that he made you think he dumped you!
Slowpokes like him, it's best to slap your feelings on their faces.
I was in the same situation. There was a friend with whom I was unable to patch things up with. so I just came right out and said how I felt, and it worked!
If it worked for me... Given the kind of girl you are, it'll definitely work for you!
Because there's something I don't have, that you've got plenty of...
Ki-Kirino-chan...
Why is she so passionate about this...?
Kirino...
Don't get the wrong idea. She might be plain and uninteresting, but it's still sad to see her hurt by your dullness.
I... see... Say, Kirino.
Hm?
Thanks.
W-What are you smiling for... gnn... Gross.
After that, there's nothing else to say...
What, you going to tell me what to do?
No. I'm actually grateful.
You did all that to create an opportunity to see Manami, and also...
I think I understand what I need to do now.
You sure?
...I think so.
Well... That's fine then.
